# Tokens

Every token of the system, a section per group: Surfaces — 3 tokens; Text — 2 tokens; Fills and status backgrounds — 1 token; Palette ramps and brand — 18 tokens; Type styles, families, font files; Spacing — 6 tokens; Radius — 4 tokens.

## Color · Surfaces

### Use

```css
/* in a page’s CSS: the token’s name, with its value from the same row of the table below as the fallback, so the page draws whether or not it links tokens.css */
color: var(--ground, #14110e);
/* on a slide, in a chart’s options, or anywhere else var() cannot go, and in an SVG attribute such as fill, which not every browser reads var() in: the value alone */
color: #14110e;
```

### Tokens (3)

| token | ember | usage |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--ground` | #14110e | Screen and page background. Text on it: ink, ink-muted, ember, amber, approve, reject. |
| `--surface` | #1e1915 | Panels and cards on ground. Text on it: ink, ink-muted. |
| `--surface-raised` | #2a231d | Cards inside panels, chips, command bar. Text on it: ink, ink-muted. |

## Color · Palette ramps and brand

### Use

```css
/* in a page’s CSS: the token’s name, with its value from the same row of the table below as the fallback, so the page draws whether or not it links tokens.css */
color: var(--line, #3d3229);
/* on a slide, in a chart’s options, or anywhere else var() cannot go, and in an SVG attribute such as fill, which not every browser reads var() in: the value alone */
color: #3d3229;
```

### Tokens (18)

| token | ember | usage |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--line` | #3d3229 | Decorative dividers and gridlines only. Under 3:1, never carries meaning. |
| `--line-strong` | #85705c | Borders that carry meaning (queued chip, dashed empty card). 3:1 or better on surface and ground. |
| `--ember` | #ff6a1a | Brand accent: blocked state, active tab, wordmark. Text on ground uses it directly; text on it uses ground. |
| `--amber` | #ffb938 | Working state and agent LEDs. Text on it uses ground. |
| `--approve` | #36d97b | Safe, done and APPROVE only. Never decoration. Text on it uses on-approve. |
| `--reject` | #ff5c5c | REJECT only. Never used for generic errors or warnings. |
| `--kill` | #c4162b | KILL switch cap and the KILL ACTIVE banner only. Text on it uses ink. |
| `--collar` | #ffd21f | Yellow collar around the kill switch. Hardware only. |
| `--acrylic` | #8fd0e6 | Edge tint and highlights of clear 3 mm acrylic. Use at 10 to 35 percent fill, solid for edges. |
| `--plywood` | #d2a066 | Warm 3 mm plywood front panel variant. Text on it uses ply-ink. |
| `--ply-ink` | #2b1b0c | Engraved or printed labels on plywood. 7:1 on plywood. |
| `--ply-grain` | #9c6b38 | Grain lines and edge shading on plywood. |
| `--steel` | #9aa0a6 | Metal parts: PTT button, screws, toggle, standoffs. |
| `--steel-dark` | #4a4f55 | Shadow side of metal parts and button bezels. |
| `--bezel` | #232120 | 3D-printed screen bezel and microphone body. |
| `--board` | #2f5655 | Raspberry Pi board. Deliberately not green so green keeps its meaning. |
| `--perf` | #b9985c | Perfboard. |
| `--desk` | #3a2e24 | Desk or table surface in scenes. |

## Type

Set text in one of the styles below: write its values from the Styles and Families tables, or, on a page that links or inlines tokens.css, prefer its variable, where the Styles table’s CSS column gives one.

### Use

```css
/* any surface: a style’s values from the Styles and Families tables */
font: 700 20px/28px "IBM Plex Sans", "Noto Sans SC", "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", system-ui, sans-serif;
/* a page that links or inlines tokens.css: prefer the variables, so that a change to tokens.css reaches the page */
font: var(--text-dash-title);
font-family: var(--font-sans);   /* the family alone */
```

### Styles

| style | CSS | size / line, italic, letter spacing | weight | family | usage |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `dash-title` | `.dash-title`, `--text-dash-title` | 20px / 28px | 700 | `sans` | Approval card headline. |
| `dash-body` | `.dash-body`, `--text-dash-body` | 14px / 20px | 400 | `sans` | Chat messages and task titles. |
| `dash-label` | `.dash-label`, `--text-dash-label` | 11px / 16px, letter-spacing 0.12em | 600 | `sans` | Panel headers, uppercase in English only. Never letter-space Chinese. |
| `dash-mono` | `.dash-mono`, `--text-dash-mono` | 13px / 18px | 400 | `mono` | Task ids, tool calls, shell commands. |
| `mini-name` | `.mini-name`, `--text-mini-name` | 44px / 56px | 700 | `mono` | Agent name and state on the 5 inch screen. |
| `mini-detail` | `.mini-detail`, `--text-mini-detail` | 28px / 36px | 400 | `mono` | One short detail line under each agent row. |
| `panel-label` | `.panel-label`, `--text-panel-label` | 12px / 16px | 700 | `sans` | Printed or engraved labels, English above Chinese. |

### Families

| family | CSS variable | stack |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `sans` | `--font-sans` | `"IBM Plex Sans", "Noto Sans SC", "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", system-ui, sans-serif` |
| `mono` | `--font-mono` | `"JetBrains Mono", "Noto Sans Mono", Menlo, monospace` |

## Spacing

### Use

```css
/* any surface: a token’s value from the table below */
padding: 4px;
/* a page that links or inlines tokens.css: prefer the token’s name, so that a change to tokens.css reaches the page */
padding: var(--space-1);
```

### Tokens (6)

| token | value | usage |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--space-1` | 4px | Gap between a dot and its label. |
| `--space-2` | 8px | Gap inside chips and between stacked labels. |
| `--space-3` | 12px | Card padding on screens. |
| `--space-4` | 16px | Screen margin and panel gap. |
| `--space-6` | 24px | Perfboard dot pitch on the cover; large gaps. |
| `--space-8` | 32px | Section gap in documentation pages. |
